subject: Launchroom bridge & host assignments for NovoMed kickoff

Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@novamed.com>

Subject: NovoMed kickoff — proposed windows & attendee ask

Hi Marcus / Ben —

Hope you both had a good week. NovoMed is ready to lock in their kickoff and they asked for two 90-minute windows next week (they have a tight exec schedule). Can you confirm availability for either:

- Tue, May 23 — 14:00–15:30 PDT (UTC-7)
- Wed, May 24 — 09:00–10:30 PDT (UTC-7)

Proposed agenda (first draft, attached):
- 0–10m: Welcome, objectives, and success metrics (Monica)
- 10–35m: Product overview & integration scope (Marcus)
- 35–65m: Technical deep-dive: API auth, VPC onboarding, data routing (Ben)
- 65–80m: Rollout timeline, next steps, action owners (Monica)
- 80–90m: Q&A / close

Attendee request from NovoMed so far: Sarah (PM), procurement (cc’d), and their infra lead (TBD). Can we also confirm internal hosts and backup hosts for timezone overlap?

Attachments: kickoff-agenda-v1.pdf

Thanks —
Monica

Host assignments (proposed):
- Welcome & success metrics — Monica Patel (primary)
- Product overview & integration scope — Marcus Lin (primary)
- Technical deep-dive — Ben Carter (primary)
- Technical backup / VPC questions — Soojin Lee (backup)
- Note-taker / follow-up owner — Marcus

Operational notes:

- We should run a 15-min tech-check with their infra lead 48 hours before the kickoff — Ben, can you own the tech-check runbook?

Calendar tentative: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=novamed-kickoff-20280519

—Marcus
